RebelAuditLog.ErrorKeepMonths: Enter a whole number of months, or 0 to keep entries forever.
RebelAuditLog.ExcludeConsole: Leave out what was done from the command line (user %s)
RebelAuditLog.Intro: Who changed what in Matomo, and when. Times are in the time zone of the database.
RebelAuditLog.NoEntries: Nothing was logged in this period.
RebelAuditLog.SettingKeepMonthsHelp: Entries older than this are deleted once a day. 0 keeps them forever. The log holds IP addresses and logins, which are personal data.
